Change the require condition from _tos.length > 0 to _tos.length == 0, making the function revert when any addresses are provided.
Delete the inner require(_s) inside the loop so failed calls no longer revert the whole transaction, changing the success/failure observable behavior.
Change the selector id to a different function signature so the external call target and behavior differ.
Return false instead of true, changing the boolean return value observable to callers.
Change the loop start to i=1 so the first recipient is skipped, altering the set of external calls made.
